cover_letter.greeting: Dear The Farmer's Dog Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Finance Analyst, Ops role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The Farmer's Dog interests me because a fresh-food subscription business lives or dies on operations, so ops finance sits close to the decisions that matter.

At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows and helped automate the order-to-cash process, which cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation.

That maps to forecasting operating costs, tracking variances and helping the ops team see the financial side of their choices. I haven't worked in D2C or food manufacturing, but I learn a business's drivers quickly and I'm comfortable building models people actually use. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
